name: time-anchor
description: A lightweight temporal-awareness organ with ambient time, active clock checks, and a Temporal Cortex.

interface.shortDescription: Bring lived time into conversational continuity.
interface.longDescription: Combines a per-conversation ambient time hook, an active clock reader, and a thin Temporal Cortex that turns verified temporal facts into an immediate update of the agent's understanding. Ordinary turns keep the independent one-in-four ambient draw, while local date crossings and gaps over two hours surface deterministically.
defaultPrompt: Use $time-anchor:time-anchor when real elapsed time may change what this message means, and let verified temporal facts update your understanding before you respond.
